change_summary: The retraction notice carries the tracked paper's title, and the paper has been retracted. The reason given is that the reported yields could not be reproduced and the raw data were found to have been altered. The paper's headline result is that a single ethanol extraction recovered 94% of the curcumin in turmeric powder, and the retraction covers the whole paper, so its findings, including the 94% yield, can't be relied on.
